profile.description: GPT-OSS-120b is a high-performance, open-weight language model designed for production-grade, general-purpose use cases. It fits on a single H100 GPU, making it accessible without requiring multi-GPU infrastructure. Trained on the Harmony response format, it excels at complex reasoning and supports configurable reasoning effort, full chain-of-thought transparency for easier debugging and trust, and native agentic capabilities for function calling, tool use, and structured outputs.
